mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased month-over-month over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and the unemployment rate signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness, which amplifies equity market risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increased month-over-month over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of instances where UNRATE declined month-over-month in the high-unemployment regime over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and associated economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of instances where HOUST > 2000 over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, which supports earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of instances where INDPRO increased month-over-month over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annually), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that triggers equity market corrections, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances where RSAFS declined month-over-month in the late-cycle expansion regime over the past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO declined month-over-month over the past 5 years.
